scans.dom:
TURF WAR
GAME RULES
5×4
GRID
14
PLAYLINES
96.01%–96.05%
RTP
20,000×
MAX WIN
HOW TO PLAY

Turf War is a 5×4 video slot with 14 fixed playlines. Winning combinations start from left to right, on adjacent reels beginning with the leftmost reel. Only the highest win is awarded per line, and all line wins are added together. The theoretical return to player (RTP) is 96.01%–96.05%, depending on the mode played — every mode's figure is listed in the table below.

CONTROLS
Spin
Starts a round for the current amount. The space bar does the same thing. While the reels are turning it becomes Stop, which brings them to rest early.
Decrease / increase
Steps the amount up or down through the available amount levels.
AMOUNT
Amount
Shows the current amount. Tap it to open the play menu and choose any of the available amount levels directly.
PLAY BONUS
Play Bonus
Opens the feature menu, where any of the three free-spin features can be started outright for the stated multiple of your amount. The total is shown before you confirm.
Auto Spin
Plays a chosen number of rounds automatically. Open it to set the count and any stop conditions; press it again to stop early.
Turbo
Shortens the spin and win presentations. Lit means turbo is on.
Menu
Opens the win table, these rules, and the sound and settings controls.
Info
Opens these game rules.
Settings
Opens the volume controls: master volume, music and sound effects, each set separately.
Win table
Lists every symbol and what it awards for 3, 4 and 5 of a kind, plus the playlines.
Sound
Mutes and unmutes the game. Volume is adjusted under Settings.

While a big win is being counted up, tapping anywhere skips to the final amount.

RTP & MAX WIN BY MODE
MODE	HOW TO ENTER	RTP	MAX WIN
Base game	Every spin	96.01%	20,000× amount
Lookout (3 Scatters)	Play for 100× amount	96.02%	20,000× amount
Muscle (4 Scatters)	Play for 500× amount	96.03%	20,000× amount
Kingpin (5 Scatters)	Play for 1000× amount	96.05%	20,000× amount

Max win is a multiple of the base amount, not of a feature's entry total. When a round reaches the cap it ends immediately and the capped amount is awarded.

WILD

The Wild substitutes for every symbol except the Scatter and the Bruiser, and awards as its own symbol on 5 of a kind.

BRUISER

The Bruiser appears on the three middle reels in the base game, and on any reel during free spins. When one lands, its entire reel is filled with Wilds before any wins are evaluated. Scatters in that reel are not replaced. The Bruiser no line win as a symbol of its own, and at most one lands on any spin.

LOOT BAGS
1×1
2×–100×
2×2
2×–10×
3×3
2×–8×

Loot Bags land on the grid and reveal a multiplier when the reels settle. A Loot Bag covers 1×1, 2×2 or 3×3 positions and carries a single value however many positions it covers. Possible values are 2× to 10×, 25×, 50× and 100× on a single position, 2× to 10× on a 2×2 Loot Bag, and 2× to 8× on a 3×3 Loot Bag.

A Loot Bag counts towards a win when a symbol it covers is part of a winning playline, and the win is multiplied by the Loot Bag's value. A larger Loot Bag counts once for each of its positions that the winning playline crosses. Where more than one Loot Bag takes part in the same win, their values are added together and the total is applied.

THE BIG SCORE
5×–50×

On any spin — in normal play and inside every feature — the entire grid can become a single Loot Bag. It carries one value from 5× to 50× applied to every position, so a winning playline is multiplied by that value once for each of its positions. The Big Score can turn up whether or not the spin has a winning line — when there is no win it simply passes.

SCATTER & FREE SPINS

The Boombox Scatter appears on all five reels in the base game, and on reels 3 to 5 during free spins. It does not award a line win on its own, and does not need to land on a playline. The number of Scatters landing together decides which feature opens, and each one awards 10 free spins:

3 SCATTERS
One Loot Bag is on the grid from the start. All Loot Bags are sticky and stay until the feature ends; between spins each is refilled with a new multiplier.
4 SCATTERS
Two Loot Bags are on the grid from the start. Loot Bag values are sticky, and any Loot Bag that takes part in a win doubles before the next spin. Each Loot Bag doubles at most once per spin.
5 SCATTERS
One Loot Bag is on the grid from the start and the doubling rule of Muscle applies. In addition, every reel a Bruiser fills with Wilds stays Wild for the rest of the feature — held Wild columns build up spin after spin.
RETRIGGERS

Landing further Scatters together during a feature awards extra free spins: 2 Scatters award +2, 3 Scatters award +4, 4 Scatters award +6 and 5 Scatters award +8. This applies in all three features.

There is no limit to the number of free spins that can be won. A feature ends when its free spins run out or when the maximum win is reached.

×2
+2
×3
+4
×4
+6
×5
+8
FEATURE ENTRY

Instead of waiting for Scatters, each feature can be started directly with the Play Bonus button, for the total shown in the table above. Each mode's RTP is shown there alongside its total; across all modes it ranges from 96.01% to 96.05%.

MAX WIN

The maximum award is capped at 20,000× the base amount in every mode. Once the cap is reached the round ends immediately and the maximum win is awarded.

Malfunction voids all wins and plays. A consistent internet connection is required. In the event of a disconnection, reload the game to finish any uncompleted rounds. The expected return is calculated over many plays. The game display is not representative of any physical device and is for illustrative purposes only. Winnings are settled according to the amount received from the Remote Game Server and not from events within the web browser. TM and © 2026 Engine.
